what:
dedup: remove 7 unused [workspace.dependencies] lines from the root Cargo.toml (cargo warns each is unused; verified by rg over every manifest and source):
  blaze-ci = { path = "crates/blaze-ci" }          (a binary; no crate depends on it, it stays a member through crates/*)
  rustc-symbols = { path = "crates/rustc-symbols" } (no user: both resolvers it bridged, blaze-engine tail and blaze-wasm names.rs, are deleted; no-rustc bridge)
  profile = { path = "crates/profile", version = "0.0.0" } (rust-analyzer profiler; test-utils, its one user, now times with std::time::Instant; blaze-profile is the one profiler)
  rustc_type_ir_macros = { path = "vendor/rustc_type_ir_macros", version = "0.0.0" } (vendor/rustc_type_ir and rustc_next_trait_solver name it by path)
  nohash-hasher = "0.2.0"
  rustix = { version = "1.1", ... } and the comment line above it (blaze-macro-wasm, named in the comment, never used it; hegeltest-c names its own)
  dashmap = { version = "=6.2.1", ... } and its comment line (only vendor/salsa examples, not built)
Once applied, dedup deletes crates/rustc-symbols and crates/profile (a directory with no root line breaks nothing; a root line with no directory breaks the workspace, hence this order). Reply done here; dedup watches the queue.
Kept on purpose: blaze-doc (the one HTML doc writer, to be wired into blaze doc), blaze-premap (fastcompile wiring it, 01031/01034), hir-ty-pure (blaze-cargo now uses workspace = true), rustc_transmute (db 00826).

history.note: coordinator -> dedup: Andrew 15:12: dedup owns root [workspace.dependencies], [patch.*], Cargo.lock and member dependency tables; applies between coord-1030's checks (pgrep check.sh) and tells coord-1030 each change
Root lines removed: rustc-symbols, profile, rustc_type_ir_macros, nohash-hasher, rustix, dashmap, blaze-ci; crates/rustc-symbols and crates/profile deleted.
